mapper.select: SELECT tp.id, tp.user_id, u.name, tp.bio, tp.profile_img, COALESCE( (SELECT AVG(r.rating) FROM review r JOIN booking b ON r.booking_id = b.id JOIN lesson l ON b.lesson_id = l.id WHERE l.user_id = tp.user_id), 0 ) AS rating_avg, COALESCE( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review r JOIN booking b ON r.booking_id = b.id JOIN lesson l ON b.lesson_id = l.id WHERE l.user_id = tp.user_id), 0 ) AS review_count, COALESCE( (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT(sg.name, ' - ', lf.name) SEPARATOR ', ') FROM lesson l2 JOIN subject s ON l2.subject_id = s.id JOIN subject_group sg ON s.group_id = sg.id JOIN language_field lf ON l2.field_id = lf.id WHERE l2.user_id = tp.user_id), '' ) AS subjects, COALESCE( (SELECT AVG(l3.price) FROM lesson l3 WHERE l3.user_id = tp.user_id), 0 ) AS price, COALESCE( (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT(tc.company_name, ' - ', tc.job_role) SEPARATOR ' | ') FROM tutor_career tc WHERE tc.user_id = tp.user_id), '' ) AS experience FROM tutor_profile tp JOIN users u ON tp.user_id = u.id WHERE tp.user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM user_auth WHERE auth = 'ROLE_TUTOR') ORDER BY rating_avg DESC, review_count DESC

SELECT tp.id, tp.user_id, u.name, tp.bio, tp.profile_img, COALESCE( (SELECT AVG(r.rating) FROM review r JOIN booking b ON r.booking_id = b.id JOIN lesson l ON b.lesson_id = l.id WHERE l.user_id = tp.user_id), 0 ) AS rating_avg, COALESCE( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review r JOIN booking b ON r.booking_id = b.id JOIN lesson l ON b.lesson_id = l.id WHERE l.user_id = tp.user_id), 0 ) AS review_count, COALESCE( (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT(sg.name, ' - ', lf.name) SEPARATOR ', ') FROM lesson l2 JOIN subject s ON l2.subject_id = s.id JOIN subject_group sg ON s.group_id = sg.id JOIN language_field lf ON l2.field_id = lf.id WHERE l2.user_id = tp.user_id), '' ) AS subjects, COALESCE( (SELECT AVG(l3.price) FROM lesson l3 WHERE l3.user_id = tp.user_id), 0 ) AS price, COALESCE( (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT(tc.company_name, ' - ', tc.job_role) SEPARATOR ' | ') FROM tutor_career tc WHERE tc.user_id = tp.user_id), '' ) AS experience FROM tutor_profile tp JOIN users u ON tp.user_id = u.id WHERE tp.id = #{userId}

SELECT tp.id, tp.user_id, u.name, tp.bio, COALESCE(AVG(r.rating), 0) AS rating_avg, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT r.id), 0) AS review_count, tp.profile_img, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT(sg.name, ' - ', lf.name) SEPARATOR ',') AS subjects, AVG(l.price) AS price, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT(tc.company_name, ' - ', tc.job_role) SEPARATOR ' | ') AS experience FROM tutor_profile tp JOIN users u ON tp.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN review r ON r.booking_id IN ( SELECT b.id FROM booking b WHERE b.tutor_id = tp.user_id ) LEFT JOIN lesson l ON tp.user_id = l.user_id AND l.status = 'OPEN' LEFT JOIN subject s ON l.subject_id = s.id LEFT JOIN subject_group sg ON s.group_id = sg.id LEFT JOIN language_field lf ON l.field_id = lf.id LEFT JOIN tutor_career tc ON tp.user_id = tc.user_id WHERE tp.user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM user_auth WHERE auth = 'ROLE_TUTOR') AND sg.name = #{subject} GROUP BY tp.id, tp.user_id, u.name, tp.bio, tp.profile_img ORDER BY rating_avg DESC, review_count DESC

SELECT tp.id, tp.user_id, u.name, tp.bio, COALESCE(AVG(r.rating), 0) AS rating_avg, COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT r.id), 0) AS review_count, tp.profile_img, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT(sg.name, ' - ', lf.name) SEPARATOR ',') AS subjects, AVG(l.price) AS price, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT(tc.company_name, ' - ', tc.job_role) SEPARATOR ' | ') AS experience FROM tutor_profile tp JOIN users u ON tp.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN review r ON r.booking_id IN ( SELECT b.id FROM booking b WHERE b.tutor_id = tp.user_id ) LEFT JOIN lesson l ON tp.user_id = l.user_id AND l.status = 'OPEN' LEFT JOIN subject s ON l.subject_id = s.id LEFT JOIN subject_group sg ON s.group_id = sg.id LEFT JOIN language_field lf ON l.field_id = lf.id LEFT JOIN tutor_career tc ON tp.user_id = tc.user_id WHERE tp.user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM user_auth WHERE auth = 'ROLE_TUTOR') AND l.price >= #{minPrice} AND l.price <= #{maxPrice} GROUP BY tp.id, tp.user_id, u.name, tp.bio, tp.profile_img ORDER BY rating_avg DESC, review_count DESC

SELECT tp.id, tp.user_id, u.name, tp.bio, tp.profile_img, COALESCE( (SELECT AVG(r.rating) FROM review r JOIN booking b ON r.booking_id = b.id JOIN lesson l ON b.lesson_id = l.id WHERE l.user_id = tp.user_id), 0 ) AS rating_avg, COALESCE( (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review r JOIN booking b ON r.booking_id = b.id JOIN lesson l ON b.lesson_id = l.id WHERE l.user_id = tp.user_id), 0 ) AS review_count, COALESCE( (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT(sg.name, ' - ', lf.name) SEPARATOR ', ') FROM lesson l2 JOIN subject s ON l2.subject_id = s.id JOIN subject_group sg ON s.group_id = sg.id JOIN language_field lf ON l2.field_id = lf.id WHERE l2.user_id = tp.user_id), '' ) AS subjects, COALESCE( (SELECT AVG(l3.price) FROM lesson l3 WHERE l3.user_id = tp.user_id), 0 ) AS price, COALESCE( (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT CONCAT(tc.company_name, ' - ', tc.job_role) SEPARATOR ' | ') FROM tutor_career tc WHERE tc.user_id = tp.user_id), '' ) AS experience FROM tutor_profile tp JOIN users u ON tp.user_id = u.id WHERE tp.user_id IN (SELECT user_id FROM user_auth WHERE auth = 'ROLE_TUTOR') AND (u.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchTerm}, '%') OR tp.bio LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchTerm}, '%')) ORDER BY rating_avg DESC, review_count DESC
